title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
availability_reason: Cemu 2.6 macOS runtime crash: the dual-selector code-cave candidate caused SIGBUS/EXC_BAD_ACCESS in PPCRecompiler before gameplay. Do not install pending GDB selector tracing.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Lobby Full Item Box

preimages.meaning: Selector 0x07 dispatch to the first restricted lobby item-box constructor.
Selector 0x08 dispatch to the alternate restricted lobby item-box constructor.

anchors.meaning: First restricted lobby item-box constructor allocates a 0x2a0-byte object.
Alternate restricted lobby item-box constructor also allocates a 0x2a0-byte object.
Home-path guard requires r31 to equal 1.
The r31 == 1 branch targets the complete home item-box constructor.
Complete home item-box constructor allocates a 0x300-byte object.
Complete home item-box GUI resource pointer low half for GUI\lobby\myh_box2_n.
Complete home item-box constructor calls the shared UI initializer.

license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: Retracted dual-selector code-cave candidate. It remains retained only as crash evidence and is runtime-blocked pending GDB selector tracing.
